notes.title: The Park is OPEN for visitors!
notes.content:
Welcome!

There is a fireworks event in the evening and your friend knows just the right place to watch it. All you have to do is get there through this perfectly normal park. 
Just follow the arrows and you'll reach your destination. Eventually. 
How hard can that be? 
And what number of acorns is enough acorns?

Watch your step and don't forget to drink your water!
